heroPosterAlt: Keynote speaker on a lit stage in front of a full auditorium
statement: At events, I work quietly and deliver edited previews the same evening. For brands and small businesses, I plan photo shoots, film Instagram Reels and create regular social media content around your goals.
ctaTitle: An event or a brand story?
ctaText: Tell me about your event, your business or the content you need. I’ll confirm availability and suggest a suitable format within one working day.
runOfShowTitle: A conference day, as I cover it

runOfShow.title: Before the doors open
runOfShow.text: The room, the stage and every sponsor banner, photographed empty and lit, before a single guest walks in.
runOfShow.alt: Banquet hall set up before guests arrive

runOfShow.title: Registration
runOfShow.text: Badges, coffee and first handshakes. The candid frames organisers use to show the event was full.
runOfShow.alt: Guests talking over drinks at registration

runOfShow.title: Opening keynote
runOfShow.text: From the stage pit: the speaker's best gestures and the audience reacting, with no flash and no distraction.
runOfShow.alt: Keynote speaker on a lit stage before a full hall

runOfShow.title: Panel discussion
runOfShow.text: Every panellist, every question from the floor, and wide frames that show the scale of the room.
runOfShow.alt: Panel discussion on a round stage

runOfShow.title: Workshops
runOfShow.text: Breakout rooms and group work: hands, whiteboards and people thinking out loud.
runOfShow.alt: Workshop group discussing notes on a wall

runOfShow.title: Closing and group photo
runOfShow.text: The final applause, the speakers together, and a group photo planned in advance so it takes two minutes.
runOfShow.alt: Full hall at the close of a conference

runOfShow.title: Previews in your inbox
runOfShow.text: A curated set of edited previews for press and social media, the same evening.
runOfShow.alt: Hands at a laptop reviewing photographs
